title: Quarterly Tax Estimate Outstanding Balance by Tax_Year
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:tax
| where payment_status!="paid"
| stats sum(tax_due_usd) as outstanding_amount count as open_records by tax_year
| sort - outstanding_amount
description: Ranks open quarterly tax estimate balances so you can see where the most money is still not settled.
value: Outstanding-balance ranking focuses your follow-up time where it matters most instead of on whatever record you looked at last.
implementation: Normalize `payment_status` so only genuinely unresolved records remain in the outstanding queue.
visualization: Bar chart of outstanding amount by tax_year.
grandmaExplanation: It totals who still owes money or has unresolved financial work in quarterly tax estimate.
